4 افسل عَلَيْهِ مَتَاعَهُ He pronounced against him (i. e. against another man, Lth, O) that his goods
were bad; syn. ارذله: (Lth, O, K:) and افسل عَلَيْهِ دَرَاهِمَهُ he pronounced against him that his dirhems, or pieces of money, were bad, or were such as are termed زُيُوف; (Lth, O, K; *) syn. زَيَّفَهَا, (Lth, O, K, TA,) and أَرْذَلَهَا: (TA:) and [in like manner] ↓ فسّلهُ , inf. n. تَفْسِيلٌ, signifies أَرْذَلَهُ and زَيَّفَهُ. (TA.) ＝
-A2- See also what next follows.
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
